subject.title: Discord compaction still fails with provider_error_4xx after #90496 closure on 2026.6.5

question: What should OpenClaw do when a Discord channel using the Codex route hits budget compaction and Codex native compaction fails with provider_error_4xx?
rationale: Current code can classify and surface the failure, but the next step is a product/session-state policy choice about actionable auth/provider guidance, preserving transcript state, and whether to rotate away from an unrecoverable channel session.

options.title: Keep Separate Recovery Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the provider-4xx Discord recovery tracker and require live Discord/Codex proof before accepting a repair.

options.title: Fold Into Timeout Work Only With Proof
options.body: Treat the timeout-progress PR as sufficient only if it also proves the Codex 403 Discord recovery path on a live or equivalent setup.

options.title: Document Manual Recovery
options.body: Accept the current fail-closed provider behavior and document the supported manual recovery path instead of adding automatic session rotation.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Recovery Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the provider-4xx Discord recovery tracker and require live Discord/Codex proof before accepting a repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently owned the merged context-engine/Codex follow-up and explicitly scoped the remaining provider_error_4xx recovery policy out of that fix.
